        links = {}
    
    link_count = 0
    max_links = 8
    
    # Start with the given path; if relative, make it absolute using cwd
    if path.startswith('/'):
        current = path
    else:
        current = cwd.rstrip('/') + '/' + path
    
    # Split into components
    components = current.split('/')
    
    # Process components left to right
    resolved = []  # Stack of resolved path components
    i = 0
    
    while i < len(components):
        component = components[i]
        
        # Empty components and '.' are skipped
        if component == '' or component == '.':
            i += 1
            continue
        
        # '..' moves to parent
        if component == '..':
            if resolved:
                resolved.pop()
            i += 1
            continue
        
        # Any other name is appended
        resolved.append(component)
        
        # Check if the current path is a symlink
        current_path = '/' + '/'.join(resolved)
        
        if current_path in links:
            link_count += 1
            if link_count > max_links:
                return None
            
            # Get the target of the symlink
            target = links[current_path]
            
            # Remove the last component from resolved (the symlink itself)
            resolved.pop()
            
            # Get the directory containing the symlink
            if resolved:
                link_dir = '/' + '/'.join(resolved)
            else:
                link_dir = '/'
            
            # Resolve target relative to the directory containing the link
            if target.startswith('/'):
                # Absolute target
                target_components = target.split('/')
            else:
                # Relative target
                if link_dir == '/':
                    target_components = target.split('/')
                else:
                    target_components = link_dir.split('/') + target.split('/')
            
            # Replace remaining components with target components and continue
            components = target_components + components[i+1:]
            i = 0
            continue
        
        i += 1
    
    # Build the result
    if not resolved:
        return '/'
    
    result = '/' + '/'.join(resolved)
    return result
